## FAQ[Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/\#faq)

### General[Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/\#general)

**How do I get started with Auterion?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#how-do-i-get-started-with-auterion)

If your vehicle runs AuterionOS, start with the [Quickstart](https://docs.auterion.com/auterion-sign-up) guide and install the required software. To purchase Skynode hardware or for other inquiries, [contact the sales team](https://auterion.com/company/contact-us/).

**Does Auterion offer paid support?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#does-auterion-offer-paid-support)

Yes. [Contact the Auterion sales team](https://auterion.com/company/contact-us/) to discuss support options.

### Technical Questions[Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/\#technical-questions)

**How do I create a Skynode diagnostic report?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#how-do-i-create-a-skynode-diagnostic-report)

Open the vehicles [WebUI](https://docs.auterion.com/vehicle-operation/settings-and-maintenance/vehicle-dashboard) and navigate to **Diagnostics** → **Download Report**.

**How do I factory reset a Skynode?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#how-do-i-factory-reset-a-skynode)

Open the vehicle's [WebUI](https://docs.auterion.com/vehicle-operation/settings-and-maintenance/vehicle-dashboard) and navigate to **Diagnostics** → **Reset**.

A factory reset removes all custom data and user applications, and clears the Auterion Suite activation.

**How do I power Skynode S?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#how-do-i-power-skynode-s)

Skynode S supports two power input methods:

- USB-C interface

- ESC interface


Use the ESC interface to ensure connected peripherals receive sufficient power. Although Skynode S can boot from USB-C alone, this method does not provide enough power for peripheral devices.

**How do I register a vehicle on Auterion Suite?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#how-do-i-register-a-vehicle-on-auterion-suite)

Complete the AMC Onboarding wizard to register your vehicle in Auterion Suite. See the [Quickstart guide](https://docs.auterion.com/auterion-sign-up) for full setup instructions.

**Which version of AMC should I use?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#which-version-of-amc-should-i-use)

Use the latest public release, available in the Suite Store and tagged as **Recommended**.

To ensure compatibility between AMC, AuterionOS, and APX4, refer to the **Bundles** section in the Suite Store.

**How do I access AuterionOS via SSH?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#how-do-i-access-auterionos-via-ssh)

Use the `ssh` command to connect to devices running AuterionOS. Default credentials are the same for all devices.

**What programming languages do I need to know to develop apps?** [Direct link to heading](https://docs.auterion.com/#what-programming-languages-do-i-need-to-know-to-develop-apps)

Apps are generally developed using C++ or Python.
